32280.sentence: A pastel patchwork of pink, blue, yellow, and green squares, each holding a heart, covers the notched-collar top and the pants, finished with pink piping and a chest pocket.
feature: Soft rainbow squares with a heart in every block, on both the top and the pants.
32280.alt: Mom and daughter in matching pastel heart-patchwork button-up velvet pajamas with notched collars.

32406.sentence: Butter-yellow gingham with light blue piping and red buttons, with little red tomatoes embroidered on the chest pocket; the pants are the same yellow gingham with blue-piped hems.
feature: Tiny embroidered tomatoes on the chest pocket of the yellow gingham top.
32406.alt: Mom and daughter in matching butter-yellow gingham button-up velvet pajamas with blue piping and a tomato pocket.

32281.sentence: Blue and cream gingham with a rounded Peter Pan collar, red piping, and red buttons; the pants are the same gingham with red-piped hems.
feature: A rounded collar trimmed in red piping on the blue gingham top.
32281.alt: Mom and daughter in matching blue gingham button-up velvet pajamas with red-piped Peter Pan collars.

32339.sentence: Charcoal-gray leopard print with a cream crochet-lace Peter Pan collar and cream buttons; the pants are the same leopard print.
feature: A cream crochet-lace collar that softens the charcoal leopard print.
32339.alt: Mom and daughter in matching charcoal leopard button-up velvet pajamas with cream lace collars.

32393.sentence: Cream with tiny multicolor confetti dots, stars, and moons, with pink piping on the notched collar, chest pocket, and cuffs; the pants carry the same confetti print with piped hems.
feature: Playful dots, stars, and moons scattered over a cream background.
32393.alt: Mom and daughter in matching cream confetti-dot button-up velvet pajamas with pink piping.
